definitions.name: Convolution Reverb
definitions.description: True convolution reverb driven by a room, plate or hall impulse response.

definitions.name: Dual Amp
definitions.description: Two parallel NAM and cabinet lanes routed hard left and right.

definitions.name: Dual Rig
definitions.description: An expandable split/merge region with independent left and right effect chains.

definitions.name: Compressor
definitions.description: Dynamics control with detector and sidechain options.

definitions.name: Noise Gate
definitions.description: Stereo-linked noise suppression with hold, hysteresis, and sidechain filtering.

definitions.name: Transient Shaper
definitions.description: Threshold-free attack and sustain shaping that reads the envelope, not the level.

definitions.name: Five Band Parametric EQ
definitions.description: High-pass and low-pass filters with selectable slopes around five fully parametric bands.

definitions.name: Stereo Widener
definitions.description: Mid/side width with the low end centred and a mono-safe side delay.

definitions.name: GCB-95 Wah
definitions.description: Circuit-modelled expression wah based on the classic GCB-95.

definitions.name: RAT Distortion
definitions.description: Circuit model of the ProCo RAT, slew-limited LM308 and all. Filter runs backwards: turn it up for less treble.

definitions.name: Big Cheese Fuzz
definitions.description: Circuit model of the Lovetone Big Cheese: a two-transistor feedback fuzz into asymmetric clipping and a Big Muff tone stack.

definitions.name: Tape Machine
definitions.description: Magnetic hysteresis and transport, voiced after a Studer A800.

definitions.name: Ladder Sweep
definitions.description: Four-pole resonant low-pass swept in time with the song.

definitions.name: Whammy
definitions.description: Pedal-swept pitch shifter. Ten Whammy presets and nine Harmony presets on one selector.

definitions.name: Harmonizer
definitions.description: Key-aware harmoniser: shifts by scale degrees so a third follows the key.
